philippines.title: Barbers warns vs China possibly acting as negotiator at Asean Summit
philippines.description:
MANILA, Philippines — Former Surigao del Norte Rep. Robert Ace Barbers has warned against the possibility that China will suddenly play negotiator when member-states convene for the Association of Southeast Asian Nations (Asean) summit, saying that the nation’s questionable actions must be considered. Barbers in a statement on Thursday urged Philippine authorities to be wary of the possible “double-talk” from China, noting that it cannot be a good negotiator if it cannot even peacefully settle differences over the West Philippine Sea (WPS). The Philippines hosts the Asean summit from November 16 to 18, but several meetings have been going on for […]...

philippines.title: PDEA agents dismantle alleged drug den in Bacoor City; 5 arrested
philippines.description:
LUCENA CITY, Quezon – Agents of the Philippine Drug Enforcement Agency (PDEA) dismantled an alleged drug den and arrested five men during an anti-illegal drug operation in Bacoor City, Cavite. In a belated report Thursday, PDEA Calabarzon said its Cavite provincial office conducted a buy-bust operation that led to the raid of the suspected drug den in Barangay Molino 3 on Wednesday night. The operation resulted in the arrest of five drug suspects. The report did not identify the drug den maintainer among the suspects.
